quarterly_data.quarter: Qnity Electronics press release: Qnity Introduces Stackplane CMP Slurry Platform for (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Qnity introduced the Stackplane family of CMP slurries for advanced packaging, combining commercialized products with next-generation slurry technologies: SP1000 and SP2000 series for hybrid bonding, SP3000 series for TSV applications, SP4000 series for polymer CMP and SP5000 series for emerging technologies such as panel-level through-glass vias (TGVs) and glass CMP. Qnity notes that many advanced packaging programs require numerous distinct CMP steps, including planarization following hybrid bonding and TSV integration. Kate Dei Cas, President, Semiconductor Technologies: 'Qnity already offers one of the industry's broadest portfolios for advanced packaging' (company claim). The slurries are evaluated in Qnity's polishing lab in Hsinchu, Taiwan. No customers or volumes are named.
quarterly_data.figure: Stackplane SP1000 to SP5000 series (hybrid bonding, TSV, polymer CMP, glass / TGV)
